projection_policy.consumer_rule: Umbrella readiness may explain why a reserved umbrella row is blocked or ready for promotion; it cannot create support claims unless the capability matrix row itself is implemented with evidence.

entries.intended_public_meaning: Objective-C 3.0 object metadata, class/category/protocol realization, property and ivar reflection, registration replay, debugger-grade reflection, source identity, and runtime query behavior are complete as an integrated runtime surface rather than a set of narrow owner rows.
forbidden_overclaims: Full object-model runtime support from class graph source alone.
Debugger-grade reflection from private snapshots or generated manifests alone.
Issue comments, PR bodies, or tmp reports as support evidence.

required_prerequisite_rows.reason: Interface method table behavior is a prerequisite for public object-model realization.
Class and metaclass graph behavior must remain implemented and evidence-backed.
Category attachment and protocol registration must remain implemented and evidence-backed.
Property and ivar reflection must remain implemented and evidence-backed.
Runtime registration reset and replay must remain implemented and evidence-backed.
Bounded runtime query snapshots must remain implemented and evidence-backed.
Public C reflection API behavior is required before the umbrella can be public.

required_source_anchors.description: Class and metaclass graph runtime source remains the object-model realization owner.
Image registration and replay source remains the runtime registration owner.
Public runtime reflection API source remains checked in and evidence-linked.
Combined object-model readiness contract ties class, metaclass, category, protocol, property, ivar, selector, reflection, and replay evidence to checked source anchors.
Debugger source identity and line-table/source-map integration must be owned by checked compiler artifacts.

required_public_commands.description: Runtime object-model conformance remains replayable through the npm bridge.
Public runtime reflection API remains replayable through the npm bridge.
Debugger-grade statement stepping and value inspection must become replayable through a public command.

required_positive_fixtures.description: Class realization behavior fixture remains checked in.
Property and ivar reflection behavior fixture remains checked in.
Debugger-grade object inspection must be covered by integrated source-map and reflection fixtures.

required_negative_fixtures.description: Invalid category attachment remains rejected by checked negative evidence.
Private testing snapshots remain internal and cannot satisfy public reflection or debugger-grade support.
Malformed object-model metadata remains fail-closed and cannot become reflectable support.
Stale or blocked reset/replay generation evidence remains lifecycle rejection/provenance rather than umbrella support.
Foreign runtime compatibility and Objective-C 2 compatibility remain explicit non-goals until implemented by their own rows.

required_runtime_probes.description: Public reflection API probe remains checked in.
Registration reset/replay generation probe remains checked in for lifecycle boundary evidence.
Debugger value inspection must prove runtime metadata through a checked probe or replay fixture.

required_abi_governance_rows.description: Public reflection ABI is represented by the current public reflection API row.
Debugger-grade reflection ABI additions must be represented in ABI governance before umbrella promotion.

required_docs.description: Hard-cutover capability truth continues to state the reserved umbrella boundary.
Object-model closure runbook remains checked in.
Combined readiness test remains checked in to enforce lifetime, source-anchor, and negative-boundary evidence.

generated_output_boundary.rule: Generated outputs may summarize checked source, fixtures, and matrix/evidence rows, but cannot satisfy object-model full-realization readiness by themselves.

promotion_blockers.summary: Debugger-grade object-model source identity is not yet complete.
missing_work: Compiler-owned source graph integration for object metadata anchors.
Source maps and native line tables for debugger stepping.
LLDB or replayable debugger protocol evidence for object value inspection.
Integrated object-model debugger fixtures and negative cases.

final_promotion_criteria: The umbrella matrix row changes to implemented in docs/support/capability_matrix.json.
All required prerequisite rows remain implemented with evidence-map rows.
Debugger-grade reflection and source identity are covered by public npm-bridge commands without relying on private snapshots or generated reports.

entries.intended_public_meaning: Objective-C 3.0 blocks, ownership, ARC cleanup, errors, async/actors, cancellation, property behaviors, metaprogramming host boundaries, and interop runtime replay are complete as a combined runtime-backed language surface rather than isolated narrow rows.
forbidden_overclaims: Advanced runtime closure from any single blocks, async, error, property, or macro row.
Cross-feature ownership correctness from generated reports alone.
Foreign runtime compatibility from interop package replay alone.
Broad runtime closure without integrated positive and negative fixtures.
Issue comments, PR bodies, or tmp reports as support evidence.

required_source_anchors.description: Block runtime copy/dispose/invoke source remains checked in.
Task and actor runtime sources remain checked in.
Error bridge runtime source remains checked in.
Combined runtime closure must be traceable through compiler-owned source graph records.

required_public_commands.description: Block ARC runtime acceptance remains replayable through the npm bridge.
Concurrency runtime conformance remains replayable through the npm bridge.

required_positive_fixtures.description: Escaping owned-object block copy/dispose fixture remains checked in.
Live continuation runtime integration fixture remains checked in.

required_negative_fixtures.description: Weak object capture mutation remains rejected by checked negative evidence.
Missing runtime replay proof remains rejected by checked negative evidence.
Cross-feature negative cases must prove unsupported or unsafe runtime combinations fail closed.

required_runtime_probes.description: Block runtime copy/dispose/invoke probe remains checked in.
Actor mailbox runtime probe remains checked in.
Integrated runtime closure probe must cover combined behavior, not isolated rows.

required_abi_governance_rows.description: Block runtime ABI must remain represented by implemented block runtime rows.
